kebab_example: aliyun hcs-mgw create-job --import-job '{OverwriteMode=always, AppendableToNormal=false, WithStorageClass=false, ConvertSymlinkTarget=false, TransferMode=all, FilterRule={FileTypeFilters={ExcludeSymlink=false, ExcludeDir=false}, KeyFilters={Includes={Regex=[.0_.jpg]}, Excludes={Regex=[.0_.jpg]}}, LastModifiedFilters={Includes={TimeFilter=[{EndTime=2006-12-31T59:59:59Z, StartTime=2006-01-01T00:00:00Z}]}, Excludes={TimeFilter=[{EndTime=2006-12-31T59:59:59Z, StartTime=2006-01-01T00:00:00Z}]}}, PrefixFilters={Includes={Prefix=[source-prefix/dir-a/]}}}, EnableMultiVersioning=false, WithLastModifyTime=true, Name=test_name, Audit={LogMode=off}, ImportQos={MaxBandWidth=1073741824, MaxImportTaskQps=1000}, ScheduleRule={SuspendCronExpression=0_0_0_0_0_0, MaxScheduleCount=1, StartCronExpression=0_0_0_0_0_0}, CreateReport=true, TargetStorageClass=Standard, SrcAddress=test_src_address, DestAddress=test_dest_address, Tags=K1:V1,K2:V2, ParentVersion=6af62558-970d-4f44-8663-4e297170fd6a}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateJob

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to migrate appendable files as normal or multipart files. Default value: false
fields.name: appendable_to_normal

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to push migration logs to Simple Log Service (SLS). To push migration logs to SLS, you must create the AliyunOSSImportSlsAuditRole role and grant the required permissions to the role. Valid values: off, basic, and detail. off: does not push migration logs. basic: pushes only migration failure logs. detail: pushes migration success logs and migration failure logs
fields.help_zh:
日志推送。推送迁移日志到SLS，需要创建AliyunOSSImportSlsAuditRole角色，并对角色完成授权。
取值： off，不推送日志；basic，仅推送文件迁移失败日志；detail，推送文件迁移成功和失败日志

fields.help_en: The full object key prefix. A maximum of 10,000 prefixes are supported by default, and each prefix can be up to 1,024 bytes in length
fields.help_zh: 完整对象 Key 前缀；默认最多 10000 条，单条最长 1024 字节
fields.name: prefix

fields.help_en: The collection of object prefixes to migrate. Multiple prefixes are matched by using OR logic
fields.help_zh: 需要迁移的对象前缀集合，多个 Prefix 按 OR 关系匹配
fields.name: includes

fields.help_en: The object prefix filtering rules, which support only Includes and apply only to full data migration tasks
fields.help_zh: 对象前缀过滤规则，只支持 Includes；仅支持全量迁移任务
fields.name: prefix_filters

fields.help_en: The filter rules
fields.name: filter_rule

fields.name: max_band_width

fields.name: max_import_task_qps

fields.name: import_qos

fields.help_en:
The task name.
The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (). The name is case-sensitive and must be UTF-8 encoded. It cannot start with a hyphen (-) or an underscore (). This parameter cannot be empty.
fields.help_zh:
任务名称。  
取值：英文小写字母、数字和特殊字符-和_，最短 3 字符， 最长 63 个字符，区分大小写，utf8 编码并且不可以- 和_开头，不能为空
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The file overwrite mode.
Valid values: \`never\` and \`always\`. \`never\`: Does not overwrite existing files. \`always\`: Overwrites existing files.
fields.help_zh:
文件覆盖方式。  
取值：never，不覆盖；always，覆盖；
fields.name: overwrite_mode

fields.help_en: The parent task ID. Specify this ID when you create a subtask to retry failed file transfers
fields.help_zh: 父任务ID。创建失败文件重试子任务时可以指定父任务ID
fields.name: parent_version

fields.help_en: The maximum number of times that the migration task is automatically scheduled. Each time the migration task is run, the execution ID increases by one until the task is run the specified number of times. The task is automatically scheduled based on the specified start time and pause time. The task is no longer automatically scheduled after the task is run the specified number of times. However, you can still manually start the task
fields.help_zh: 自动调度轮次限制，任务执行ID在轮次限制内（任务从开始到结束为一轮执行）会根据启动时间和暂停时间自动调度，超过轮次限制不再自动调度，但是依然可以手动执行
fields.name: max_schedule_count

fields.help_en: The time when the migration task started. You can use a CRON expression to specify the time. The interval at which the migration task is run is at least 1 hour
fields.help_zh: 启动时间，Cron表达式，间隔不低于1小时
fields.name: start_cron_expression

fields.help_en: The time when the migration task paused. You can use a CRON expression to specify the time. The interval at which the migration task is run is at least 1 hour
fields.help_zh: 暂停时间，Cron表达式，间隔不低于1小时
fields.name: suspend_cron_expression

fields.help_en: The scheduling rule
fields.name: schedule_rule

fields.help_en: The name of the source data address
fields.name: src_address

fields.help_en:
The tags, in key-value format.
Allowed characters include uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The maximum length is 1024 characters.
fields.help_zh:
标签，KeyValue格式。   
允许字符：英文大小写字母、数字和特殊字符-_,。长度限制：1024个字符
fields.name: tags

fields.help_en: Specifies the StorageClass for destination files. The destination address can only be OSS. Valid values: Standard, IA, Archive, ColdArchive, DeepColdArchive
fields.help_zh: 指定设置目的文件的storageClass，目的地址只能是oss。 合法值：Standard IA Archive ColdArchive DeepColdArchive
fields.name: target_storage_class

fields.help_en:
The file transfer mode.
Valid values: \`all\` (full transfer) and \`lastmodified\` (incremental transfer).
\`OverwriteMode\` and \`TransferMode\` are used together:

\`always\` and \`all\`: Forces a full overwrite. \`always\` and \`lastmodified\`: Overwrites files based on their last modified time. \`never\` and an empty value for \`TransferMode\`: Does not overwrite files with the same name
fields.name: transfer_mode

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to preserve the lastModifyTime. Default value: true
fields.name: with_last_modify_time

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to migrate the StorageClass property. This is allowed only for OSS-to-OSS migration
fields.name: with_storage_class
